underlying_goal: Fix a 1px white line artifact appearing on video thumbnails when hovering, caused by the Vimeo iframe rendering
friction_detail: Initial fix only addressed the top edge white line, but the artifacts were on all edges, requiring user to report the remaining issue.
brief_summary: User wanted to fix white pixel artifacts on Vimeo thumbnail hover; first fix only addressed the top edge, requiring a second iteration to extend the fix to all edges.
